//: Parity fixture for the Railway->Epik migration. Every `status` is what server.cjs returns TODAY; Phase 3 runs this SAME list against BOTH the live Railway site and staged Epik, and any deviation from `status` on either stack is a blocker. Redirects are checked WITHOUT following (we assert the 301 code + Location). `note` explains which server.cjs layer each case exercises.

cases.note: live product — served from disk (Layer 3 / .htaccess rule 2)
live product WITH trailing slash — must 200, NOT 301 (no DirectorySlash redirect)
wrong-case slug — product-shaped, case-sensitive file miss -> 410 on both stacks
deleted product WITH a mapped replacement -> 301 (Layer 4.5 / resolver redirect map)
product-shaped, deleted, NOT in map -> 410 + noindex
product-shaped but NEVER existed (not deleted) -> still 410, matching server.cjs
category index — SPA route on disk (Layer 3)
search route (Layer 3). Note: /search?id=/?cat= layers were dropped; bare /search is unchanged
static file (carries a UTF-8 BOM — must be preserved)
static asset — correct MIME + year-immutable cache header (Layer 4 / .htaccess FilesMatch)
non-product genuine miss -> SPA shell at 200 (Layer 5). NOT a 404, by design
